_comment: The durations (3, 6, 8 and 12 months) and the separate one-time plan come
from the original requirement notes. Deliverables, exclusions and prices
have NOT been confirmed by the business, so every plan here has
price_minor_units: null and is_pricing_confirmed: false. The public page
renders 'Price confirmed with you before work starts' rather than a figure.
Before launch: confirm each plan's deliverables, exclusions and price, set
price_minor_units (in paise for INR) and is_pricing_confirmed to true, then
re-run `npm run db:seed`. Deactivate a plan by setting is_active to false
rather than deleting the row, so existing inquiries keep their reference.
